[[No overall control]]{{efn|Liberal Democrats/Labour/Green coalition}} | after_election = | after_party = }} The '''2026 West Oxfordshire District Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 16 of 49 members of [[West Oxfordshire District Council]] in [[Oxfordshire]], [[England]].{{Cite web|title=West Oxfordshire District Council|url=https://www.westoxon.gov.uk/about-the-council/elections-and-voting/current-and-future-elections/|website=www.westoxon.gov.uk|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}}{{Cite web|title=Local elections: Two Oxfordshire councils reject delay offer|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2xew7x314o|website=www.bbc.com|date=2026-01-09|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}} Due to ongoing [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|local government reorganisation]], this will be the final election to West Oxfordshire District Council before it is abolished and replaced by a successor [[unitary authority]].
